item.title: Identifying old-growth forests in Northern Europe requires common scientific criteria
item.description: Old-growth forests are some of Europe's most valuable natural ecosystems, but they are also among the most threatened. Their role in conserving biodiversity, regulating the climate, preserving cultural heritage and supporting people's well-being is invaluable. According to a rough estimate, only around 3% of Europe's forests meet the criteria for primary or old-growth forests, and their extent continues to decline rapidly in Northern Europe. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: New cat species identified in Bolivia for first time in more than a century
item.description: New species of wild cat was discovered in Bolivia’s Yungas forest and is smaller than the average domestic ⁠cat A diminutive wild cat that inhabits Bolivia’s ⁠cloud forest has been identified as a previously unknown species, marking the first time a new living cat species has been formally named and described in more than a century. The cat, called Tilcayo by local communities, is part of a group called tiger ⁠cats found across much of South ⁠America. It was found in Bolivia’s ​lush Yungas forest, a mountainous region where forests are often covered by clouds and surrounded by high humidity… Publicado también por: The Guardian - Environment, The Hindu - International, South China Morning Post. Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.description: La molestia de los transportistas y los dueños de automóviles por el alto precio de los combustibles se siente a nivel mundial. En países europeos como Francia y Alemania, en Asia con Siria y Pakistán hasta América Latina con Guatemala y Bolivia, el costo de la gasolina ha desatado manifestación y presión sobre los Gobiernos para subsidiar a la población meses después del cierre del estratégico estrecho de Ormuz. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Milei impulsa una ley para defender la soberanía argentina sobre las Malvinas
item.description: Este jueves el presidente argentino, Javier Milei , ha enviado al Congreso un proyecto de ley que endurece las sanciones contra las empresas que operen en las islas Malvinas sin autorización de su Gobierno . La Ley de Defensa de la Soberanía Nacional incluye artículos referidos a la seguridad nacional y cambios en el sistema de inteligencia. También propone la creación de un Consejo de Seguridad Nacional para la protección de infraestructuras críticas. La Casa Rosada se refirió a la iniciativa como «un hito en el proceso de recuperación de las islas Malvinas , Georgias del Sur y Sandwich del… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

Por otro lado, el mandatario colombiano, Aberlardo de la Espriella, anunció que habilitaría el ingreso de la Fuerza Pública a las universidades durante protestas, un tema delicado en el país por casos históricos de violencia dentro de instituciones educativas. item.title: New cat species identified in Bolivia, first in over a century
item.description: A ⁠diminutive wild cat that inhabits Bolivia’s cloud forest has been identified as ⁠a previously unknown species, marking the first time a new living cat species has been formally named and described in more than a century. The cat, called Tilcayo by local communities, is part of a group called tiger cats found across much of South America. It was found in Bolivia’s lush Yungas forest, a mountainous region where forests are often covered by clouds and surrounded by high humidity, according to... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: What ancient Mars rocks reveal about its buried carbonate stores
item.description: Carbonate minerals are among the best records of past liquid water on Mars: They form when water carrying dissolved carbon dioxide reacts with rock, and their composition reflects the chemistry of both. Yet Mars has surprisingly little carbonate on its surface compared with what climate models predict, given that the planet likely had a (at least transiently) thick, CO2-rich atmosphere more than 3 billion years ago. Fuente: Phys.org.
